blocks.content: Course: Python Numpy for Data Science
In this Python NumPy for Data Science course, you'll learn:

items: How to create 1-D and n-D NumPy arrays
Methods to manipulate data in arrays, and much more

blocks.content: This course is a fantastic introduction to NumPy in the most interactive way possible. Here's how the learning process works:

items: Reinforce your learning with quizzes, exercises, and a project.

blocks.content: By the end, you'll be writing multiple programs using NumPy and feel confident working with NumPy arrays.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
